market_metadata.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the arrest occurs.
market_metadata.rules_primary: If Benjamin Netanyahu has been arrested before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
market_metadata.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, "arrested" means:
Being taken into physical custody by law enforcement authorities (including federal, state, local, military, or international law enforcement)
Voluntarily surrendering to law enforcement authorities in response to an arrest warrant
Being formally booked or processed following detention

The following scenarios would satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Benjamin Netanyahu is handcuffed and taken to a police station
Benjamin Netanyahu surrenders at a police station or courthouse with their attorney
Benjamin Netanyahu is arrested in any country and this is reported by a Source Agency
Benjamin Netanyahu is detained at an airport or border crossing and formally arrested

The following scenarios would NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
An arrest warrant being issued but not executed
Benjamin Netanyahu being briefly detained but not arrested
Benjamin Netanyahu being questioned or interviewed without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being placed under house arrest or electronic monitoring without physical custody
Benjamin Netanyahu being named in an indictment without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being arrested after Nov 1, 2026
Protective custody that is not an arrest

For standard legislation requiring executive approval, this includes final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods. For executive orders, this includes official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness.
